display.purpose: Post detail title only. Source Serif 4 bold, fluid clamp.

headline.purpose: Section headings inside the chrome. Mono, bold.

title.purpose: Card titles. Source Serif 4. Lifts to accent on hover.

body.purpose: Default body text outside the article. Mono.

label.purpose: Nav, metadata, kbd hints. Mono uppercase, tracked.

shadows.name: card-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Accent-tinted glow under post cards on hover. The only branded shadow in the system.

shadows.name: code-block-separator
shadows.purpose: Subtle ambient shadow on .astro-code blocks to lift them off the prose surface.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Ease-out-quart used for fade-in-up reveals on page load and the cmd-in animation.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default ease for hover state transitions on cards, nav links, icon buttons.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover state transitions on chrome (nav, icon buttons, tag pills).

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Card hover transitions (background, border, shadow, lift).

motion.name: dot-squish-loop
motion.purpose: Bouncing dot after the wordmark. The only ambient motion.

components.name: Post Card
components.description: The signature list item: post title, datetime, description, tag pills, faded OG image bleeding from the right.
components.html:
• A blog post about the thing

    14 Mar 2026

    A short description that gets clamped after three lines so the card stays a predictable height.

    • # devops
    • # ci-cd
components.css: .ds-card-post { list-style: none; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 20%, transparent); transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); margin: 1rem 0; } .ds-card-post:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 40%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 70%, transparent); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent); } .ds-card-post__inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-post__title { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--foreground); transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); margin: 0; } .ds-card-post:hover .ds-card-post__title { color: var(--accent); } .ds-card-post__date { font-family: 'Google Sans Code', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 60%, transparent); margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-card-post__desc { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 70%, transparent); margin: 8px 0 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-post__tags { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 12px 0 0; padding: 0; }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Always carries a hash glyph. Border + low-alpha fill in the accent. Lifts on hover.
components.html: devops
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent); padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Google Sans Code', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent); } .ds-tag__hash { opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Mono uppercase, tracked. Lifts to accent + accent/8 background on hover. Active state draws a 2px accent underline via ::after.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Google Sans Code', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 75%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: var(--accent); position: relative; } .ds-nav-link--active::after { content: ''; display: block; height: 2px; margin-top: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 36px square utility button. Hover tints with accent.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 75%, transparent); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: Code references inside prose. Mono, accent-coloured, low-alpha muted background. Every inline-code is a small flash of cursor-blink.
components.css: .ds-code-inline { display: inline; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 80%, transparent); color: var(--accent); font-family: 'Google Sans Code', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; word-wrap: break-word; }

components.name: Wordmark with Bouncing Dot
components.description: The brand mark. Italic Source Serif 4, plus a 2-unit orange dot that runs an infinite squish-and-bounce. The only ambient motion in the entire system.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-wordmark__name { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-wordmark__dot { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-bottom: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); will-change: transform; animation: ds-dot-squish 0.8s infinite; } .ds-wordmark__dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -3px; width: 6px; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 15%, transparent); transform: translateX(-50%); animation: ds-dot-shadow-squish 0.8s infinite; } @keyframes ds-dot-squish { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1, 1); } 15% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1.3, 0.7); } 30% { transform: translateY(-10px) scale(0.85, 1.15); } 50% { transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1, 1); } 70% { transform: translateY(-10px) scale(0.85, 1.15); } 85% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1.25, 0.75); } } @keyframes ds-dot-shadow-squish { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1); opacity: 0.3; } 15% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1.4); opacity: 0.35; } 50% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0.4); opacity: 0.05; } 85% { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1.4); opacity: 0.35; } }

narrative.overview:
Wicksipedia inherits the lineage of the terminal, then warms it. Monospace is the voice of the interface; Source Serif 4 is the voice of the writing. The single committed accent (Cursor-Blink Orange) is the only thing that raises its volume on the page, and it raises it for the same reason a cursor blinks: here, look. Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth appears only as a response to a hover, a click, a focus.

The aesthetic philosophy is editorial restraint with a developer's wink. Whitespace is generous because the writing is dense. The wordmark is followed by a small orange dot that bounces and squishes; that dot is the entire personality budget of the chrome. Everything else holds still.

The system explicitly rejects: the default AstroPaper / Hugo / Substack chrome, the Tailwind-template lookalike, corporate SaaS hero-metric layouts, and performative dev-blog weirdness. Authority comes from substance, not from polish.
keyCharacteristics: Mono-forward chrome, serif-driven prose. The split is deliberate.
One accent (Cursor-Blink Orange). No second colour. No gradients on the accent.
Flat surfaces at rest. Hover-lift (-2px translate) and accent-tinted glow are the only depth signals.
Twin themes (paper-warm light, deep-dock dark) are first-class, not an afterthought.
The bouncing dot after the wordmark is the only ambient motion. Everything else is state-driven.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cursor-Blink Orange is the only accent. Tailwind's --accent-2 (green) is defined for legacy reasons and must not be used in any UI. Introducing a second colour breaks the brand.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never #fff. Never #000. Every neutral tilts toward warmth (light theme) or deep-dock navy (dark theme). Pure neutrals are forbidden.

rules.name: The Low-Alpha Accent Rule
rules.body: When the accent is used as a background fill (tag pills, hover states, code-inline), it is always low-alpha (accent/5 to accent/15). The accent at full opacity is reserved for text, borders at intent, and the one-pixel top-of-viewport line.

rules.name: The Mono-Chrome / Serif-Prose Rule
rules.body: Monospace for everything outside the article body; serif for everything inside. Headings inside prose flip to monospace because they're chrome-of-the-article. Do not collapse this split.

rules.name: The 65-75ch Rule
rules.body: Article body line length sits between 65 and 75 characters.

rules.name: The Italic-as-Voice Rule
rules.body: Italic is reserved for the wordmark, h3 inside prose, and blockquote prose. It is not used decoratively elsewhere.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat in its default state. No ambient cards, no decorative shadows, no glassmorphism on idle elements.

rules.name: The Accent-Tinted-Glow Rule
rules.body: When a hover state generates a shadow, the shadow is tinted with the accent (typically accent/5). Generic black shadows are forbidden.

dos: Do use Cursor-Blink Orange (#ae4508 / #ff7a1a) for every interactive, every emphasis, every brand mark. Use it sparingly: on text, borders at intent, low-alpha tints. Never as a full-opacity background fill.
Do keep every surface flat at rest. The only elevation is hover-state on cards (accent-tinted glow + -2px lift) and the small shadow-sm on code blocks.
Do keep the Mono-Chrome / Serif-Prose rule. Monospace (Google Sans Code) for chrome and headings; serif (Source Serif 4) for article body.
Do tint every neutral toward warmth (light) or deep-dock navy (dark). Never #fff or #000.
Do cap article body line length at 65-75ch via max-w-app and prose font sizing.
Do carry the bouncing-dot motif when introducing new homepage sections that need a personality beat. It is the system's signature.
Do test every UI change in both light and dark themes before shipping. Twin themes are first-class.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for the bouncing dot, card lift, and reveal animations. WCAG 2.1 AA is the floor.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent colour. The --accent-2 (green) variable exists for legacy reasons and must not be used in any UI.

Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px as a coloured accent on cards, callouts, alerts, or list items. The current blockquote (border-s-[3px] border-s-accent) violates this and is on the to-fix list.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text on a gradient background). Cursor-Blink Orange at full opacity carries emphasis.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The header uses backdrop blur because it is sticky over scrolling content; that is structural.
Don't ship hero-metric templates (big number + small label + supporting stats + gradient accent). The site is editorial, not marketing.
Don't ship identical card grids (icon + heading + text, repeated). The post-card pattern is the only card pattern.
Don't introduce stock illustrations, mascots, or 'Trusted by' bars. The voice is dry; the chrome should be dry too.
Don't add ambient shadows, decorative gradients, or 'alive at rest' effects to surfaces. The bouncing dot is the entire personality budget.
Don't rebrand toward a Substack / Medium look (big author photo at top of post, sidebar metadata, generic serif).
Don't introduce performative weirdness (random emojis in chrome, ironic Comic Sans, gratuitous wobbles) as a substitute for personality.
